# Michael T. Wolfinger

> Independent Principal Investigator in computational RNA biology, based in Vienna, Austria. Research on RNA secondary structure, folding kinetics, functional RNA design, RNA-protein recognition, and structured viral RNAs; author of tools in the ViennaRNA ecosystem. Independent research is conducted through RNA Forecast (https://rnaforecast.com).

Michael T. Wolfinger held positions at the University of Vienna (University Assistant and Principal Investigator, 2019-2025), a Visiting Professorship (W2 Substitute Chair) at the University of Freiburg (2023-2024), and postdoctoral positions at the University of Vienna and the Medical University of Vienna. Since 2025 he pursues independently led research and collaborates with academic groups, including the Theoretical Biochemistry Group at the University of Vienna.

Identifiers: ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0925-5205 · Google Scholar https://scholar.google.at/citations?user=w0PHGnEAAAAJ · Contact michael.wolfinger@rnaforecast.com

## Structured data

Every page embeds schema.org JSON-LD: a Person node (https://michaelwolfinger.com/#person) with ORCID and profile links, BlogPosting nodes for posts, ScholarlyArticle nodes keyed by DOI for papers, and an ItemList of all papers on the publications page.
